paragraphs.text: Convert a Google Research Harness2 harness tree into a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent-preset bundle
# harness2-dsh

Turn a Google Research **Harness²** harness tree into a
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) **agent-preset bundle

** you can
install and select like any other preset.
Harness² searches for a better agent harness around a frozen model and writes the winner to disk as

a
plain directory. DSH runs agents from declarative presets. This tool is the bridge between the two

: it
reads the harness directory and emits an installable DSH bundle.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why
Running Harness² end to end means OpenCode or Codex, a Linux toolchain, and model credentials. If yo

u
already run DSH, you can keep the part that matters — the *harness it found* — and run it natively
already run DSH, you can keep the part that matters — the *harness it found* — and run it natively.
### Why not just install one of the existing Harness² DSH plugins?
As of 2026-10-22 there are about seven community attempts at "Harness² on DSH", all started within d

ays
of Harness² itself and all at 0–2 stars. None appears in the official DSH plugin catalog (3,261

entries,
zero `Harness2` matches), and each falls into one of three shapes:
| Approach | What it does | Why it is not enough on its own |
| Sidecar Python driver | Reuses Harness²'s own recursion loop, drives `dsh` as the executor | POSIX

-only; needs a separate venv and a second install step |
| In-tree Cordis plugin | Reimplements prop
ose–probe–compose inside DSH | Large surface; the ones published so far ship a demo adapter, not a t

ask executor |
| **This tool** | **Transports a harness Harness² already found into a DSH preset** |
Does not run the search itself — and that is the point |
This project deliberately does **one** thing: it is the missing *transport* step. It does not reimpl

ement
Harness², does not call a model, and has no opinion about whether a harness is good. That make

s it small
enough to be correct, testable without DSH installed, and usable alongside whichever sear

ch approach you
pick — run Harness² wherever you like, then convert the winner.
It also catches two failure modes that silently produce a broken preset:
- DSH requires kebab-case skill names; Harness² accepts underscores. `ledger_math` is *silently drop

ped*
by DSH. This tool renames it and rewrites the frontmatter to match.
- DSH does not advertise a
skill without a `description:`. This tool synthesises one and tells you.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Python 3.10+, no dependencies.
## Use
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`convert` accepts three input shapes, so you rarely need to hunt for the tree by hand:
| You point at | It converts |

| a harness directory (`systemprompt.md` present) | that tree |
| a library entry (`harness/` + `EXP

ERIENCE.md`) | the adopted harness |
| a task run directory (`summary.json` + `harnesses/`) | the ha

rness selection actually adopted |
| a domain library directory with one entry | that entry |
### Options
| Flag | Default | Meaning |

| `--preset-id` | from `--name` / output dir | lowercase letters, digits, hyphens |
| `--name` | the

id | display name in the preset picker |
| `--description` | generated | preset description |
| `--

order` | `50` | roster position |
| `--persona-mode` | `append` | `append` keeps DSH's own system pr

ompt and adds the harness text; `replace` makes the harness text the whole system prompt |
| `--skil
l-path-mode` | `package` | `package` resolves the installed bundle by name, so the bundle stays port
able; `absolute` bakes the resolved path (this machine only); `dsh-home` emits `dshHomePath(...)` fo

r bundles under `$DSH_HOME` |
| `--with-subagents` | off | convert `sub_agents/` into child presets

|
| `--no-scripts` | off | skip `scripts/` |
| `--profile` | `web` | profile named in the generated

pts` | off | skip `scripts/` |
| `--profile` | `web` | profile named in the generated install hint |
## What maps to what
| Harness² component | Becomes in DSH |
| `systemprompt.md`, `guardrails.md`, `LongTermMEMORY.md`, `tool_descriptions/tool_guidance.md` | on

e always-on block in the preset's `dsh-persona` prefix, in Harness²'s own order |
| `skills/<n>/SKIL
L.md` + `skills/<n>/scripts/` | real DSH skills under the bundle, wired through `dsh-skill-filesyste

m.customSkillDirs` |
| `scripts/<n>.py` | copied into the bundle; the persona block names where they

live |
| `sub_agents/<n>/AGENT.md` | a child agent preset plus a `dsh-tool-subagent` row (opt-in) |
| `plugin/<n>.ts` | **not converted** — OpenCode plugin modules are not Cordis plugins. Reported, n
ever silently dropped |
### Portable by default
A converted bundle contains **no machine-specific paths**, so you can commit it, hand it to a collea

gue,
or download someone else's. The preset locates its skills by asking the Loader to resolve the b

undle's own
package name from the profile's `node_modules`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This is the same mechanism the shipped `standard` preset uses for its bundled skills. It was verifie

d by
moving a generated bundle to a different directory, installing it there, and loading its skill.
Use `--skill-path-mode absolute` only when you want a fixed path (single-machine use, or the bundle

lives
somewhere the package resolver cannot see). `--skill-path-mode dsh-home` remains available for

bundles
installed under `$DSH_HOME`.
> Note: `dsh-agent-preset` needs the `agentPresets` service, which the **web** profile provides and

the
> **headless** profile does not. A converted preset is selectable in the Web UI; a headless one-

shot run
> cannot mount it. Plan verification accordingly.
## Limitations
- One-way. Converting back from a preset to a Harness² tree is not implemented, because a preset is

a
composition, not a file tree.
- `plugin/*.ts` has no automatic equivalent; porting is manual.
- `-

-skill-path-mode absolute` binds the bundle to the machine that produced it. The default `package`
m

ode avoids that, but it needs the bundle installed through the package manager (a plain copy into
`n

ode_modules` by hand will still resolve, as long as the package name is findable).
- The converter d

oes not run Harness² and does not evaluate whether the harness is any good. It only
transports what

s² and does not evaluate whether the harness is any good. It only
transports what Harness² produced.
